learning_outcomes.text: Inform students about design and construction of web pages and web-based internet applications.
Introduction to up-to-date technologies which are used for web development.
Emphasis on HTML and CSS standards, basic web design techniques, scripting languages, search engine optimization and web accessibility.
Developing and complex web-based applications for the World Wide Web or an intranet.

syllabus_topics: HyperText Markup Language (syntax, language encoding, special characters)
The eXtensible Markup Language (XML syntax and semantic, Entity references, The Extensible Hypertext Markup Language, Relationship XHTML to HTML)
Web accessibility (accessible and legible content, clear and understandable information, simple and comprehensible navigation, technically competent and structured code)
teaching_methods: Work with text (with textbook, with book)

assessment_methods.method: Semester thesis (preparation and defense of a simple web application)

assessment_rules: Credit is awarded for the preparation and defense of a semester thesis after meeting specific conditions, including minimum scope, graphic standard, valid HTML and CSS, responsiveness, API interface, and presentation. The final grade is a total evaluation of 80% semester work + 20% test. The exam is an electronic test with 20 questions, 15 minutes, and four possible answers, only one correct. Grading scale: A: <100; 95>%, B: (95; 90>%, C: (90; 85>%, D: (85; 80>%, E: (80 ; 75>%, F: (75; 0>%.
